mission_10: Congratulations on completing the Calculus chapter! You have implemented gradient descent from scratch and compared it with the analytical normal equation solution. After 1000 iterations, gradient descent converges very close to the exact solution. The momentum variant accelerates convergence by accumulating velocity. You now understand the mathematical machinery behind every ML training loop: derivatives give the gradient, the gradient gives the direction, and the learning rate controls the step size. Combined with your linear algebra knowledge, you have the mathematical foundation for understanding and implementing machine learning algorithms.
